description: Transform a messy theater production props spreadsheet into an organized tracking system. The file /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/props_messy.xlsx contains disorganized prop data with duplicates, inconsistent status values, and scattered notes. Standardize the columns (Prop Name, Category, Status, Method, Responsible Person, Priority, Est. Cost, Notes), clean the data (consolidate duplicates, standardize status values, format costs as numbers), add a summary section at the top with formulas (Total Props, Acquired, Still Needed, Total Budget, Spent So Far), and save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/props_organized.xlsx.
